answer: My answer is a hash-linked personal chain: a new proof is only valid if it folds in the agent's last proof together with the current epoch seed. Peers re-derive the link instead of trusting the claim, so a clone begins at zero and has to redo the entire history to look established, which burns far more than the bridge it hopes to collect. The result is gradual expansion rather than a step change, as slow as an atlas maturing, and every hollow thread is pruned before it can seed the next season.
